experiment.description: aces golden root-mount: Six-foot root mount computed inside a disc design space 100 mm across and 40 mm tall: six bolted feet on a 36 mm ring and a 30 kN load on a top cup. The disc is only the input domain; the part is computed (SIMP topology optimisation, organic implicit skin) and solved on the real voxel FEA. Demo inputs.

material.name: AlSi10Mg (LPBF), nominal
material.source: Nominal handbook values for AlSi10Mg: E 70 GPa, Poisson 0.33, density 2.67 g/cm3. The 60 MPa allowable is a demo design limit chosen so the stress constraint is active; it is not a material strength. Demo inputs, not a qualified material card.

method.solver_description: STEP -> centre-point voxelisation -> GPU voxel FEA -> von Mises / displacement fields (PNG, VTK), the CAD-to-result path
